video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Coach J.B. Bickerstaff l 10.02.26

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the return of JD to the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: our expectation was that he was always going to be back
quotes.quote: We are obviously excited to have him back. Again, like I said yesterday, our expectation was that he was always going to be back, and we were planning accordingly. But to get it done, to get him in the building, to start the process of getting him back on the court with the group, it is great for us. We know how much he means to us, how important he has been for the past couple years and how important he is going to be for us moving forward in the future. So, that is our guy, he has been our guy, we are happy to have him back.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff says the Pistons always expected JD to return to the team. He noted that getting him back in the building to start the process is great for the group as they look toward the future.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff denies any bitterness regarding JD's contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: there has never been any bitterness between the group and how we feel about him
quotes.quote: I do not know where that came from. It is negotiation, it is business, but there has never been any bitterness between the group and how we feel about him and I know how he feels about us. It seems like you guys are just united across the board in having that confidence that JD would eventually be back. What led to that was the relationship that we have established.
quotes.social_post: Pistons coach J.B. Bickerstaff dismissed reports of bitterness regarding JD's contract negotiations. He stated that it is just business and that there has never been any animosity between the team and the player.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff on the importance of JD's return to the team
quotes.excerpt: the most important thing for us was having JD back with us
quotes.quote: If you find yourself in these situations and you understand the business of basketball, what we try to do is bigger than that. The way that we feel about JD, the way that his teammates feel about JD, and the way that JD feels about his team, his teammates, business is what it is, but it is negotiations. And at the end of the day, you understand that it is negotiations and it is competitive. You do not get to this point, whether you are an agent, a player, a front office member, without being competitive. So you get into it from a competitive standpoint, but also being mindful of what is the most important thing. And the most important thing for us was having JD back with us, and I know JD wanted to be here.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff on the business of basketball. He says while negotiations are competitive, the priority for the Pistons was always ensuring JD returned to the team.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff on JD's individual preparation during his absence
quotes.excerpt: he was working on his own. You will see when he gets back, he is in great shape
quotes.quote: In this position, typically, guys find their solitude, so to speak, where they are doing a lot of stuff on their own. We did have guys and coaches going out and spending time with him, but he was working on his own. You will see when he gets back, he is in great shape, he is fit, he is ready to go out and help us. The hardest part of our business is the business of basketball. Other than that, it is a game. So he will be ready to go, we will make sure we take our time to make sure he is properly prepared, but we are excited to have him back.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff says JD is in great shape and ready to go after working on his own during his absence. The team plans to take their time to ensure he is properly prepared for the season.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff expects continued growth from JD this season
quotes.excerpt: he has not reached his ceiling, so there is no reason why we would not expect him
quotes.quote: Every year with young guys, you expect growth, and he has not reached his ceiling, so there is no reason why we would not expect him to take another step. And I know that is what he wants to do. He wants to continue to get better, reach greatness, and help this team in so many different ways, and we know his skill set is capable of that. So, like I said, we are excited to have him back, we are looking forward to it, but this was our plan all along.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff expects continued growth from JD this season, noting that the young player has not yet reached his ceiling and is focused on reaching greatness.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff emphasizes the team's focus on basketball over outside noise
quotes.excerpt: our guys in this group does a great job of making the main thing the main thing
quotes.quote: Our guys in this group does a great job of making the main thing the main thing. And the things that they can control, we all work and focus on that. We cannot control some of the decisions that are made, negotiations that happen, outside noise and chaos, we cannot control that stuff. So our guys have done a great job of establishing a personality that they keep the main thing the main thing and focus on what is in front of them.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff says the Pistons focus on keeping the main thing the main thing and ignoring outside noise and chaos that the team cannot control.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff on building genuine relationships to navigate difficult times
quotes.excerpt: the most important thing that we can do is build genuine relationships
quotes.quote: It is just consistency. When we first showed up here, we said the same thing. The most important thing that we can do is build genuine relationships because difficult times are going to happen in the NBA. And if you wait till the difficult times to try to have communication or try to have relationship building, it is too late. So we have always focused on building genuine relationships, and that is the reason why you do it.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff emphasizes that building genuine relationships is the key to navigating difficult times in the NBA. He says you cannot wait for the hard times to start building those connections.
